title: Playboy Magazine June 2002 Playmate of the Year Curt Schilling Shakira
conditionDescription: Pre-owned issue, complete. Normal signs of age and storage; possible light edge wear, corner wear, surface marks or creases. Please review the photo for exact condition. The centerfold has not been separately verified - please ask before buying if that matters to you.
descriptionText:
Playboy Magazine, June 2002 issue. Cover price $4.99.

Features:
- The Playmate of the Year - cover and pictorial
- World Series MVP Curt Schilling interview
- The FAA: more frightening than terrorists
- Shakira, the next pop princess
- Oscar De La Hoya 20Q
- Rock Star Fashion; Playmates in Prime Time
